note: Spider 1.0 dev, stratified sample by official hardness: 300 of 1034 proportional within each level, random.Random(2026). id is the question's index in dev.json. Built by experiments/build_spider_eval.py.

questions.question: Which states have both owners and professionals living there?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT state FROM Owners INTERSECT SELECT state FROM Professionals

questions.question: What is the average age of the dogs who have gone through any treatments?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT avg(age) FROM Dogs WHERE dog_id IN ( SELECT dog_id FROM Treatments )

questions.question: Which professionals have done at least two treatments? List the professional's id, role, and first name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.professional_id ,  T1.role_code ,  T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

questions.question: What is the name of the breed with the most dogs?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.breed_name FROM Breeds AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.breed_code  =  T2.breed_code GROUP BY T1.breed_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which owner has paid for the most treatments on his or her dogs? List the owner id and last name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.owner_id ,  T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id JOIN Treatments AS T3 ON T2.dog_id  =  T3.dog_id GROUP BY T1.owner_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Give me the description of the treatment type whose total cost is the lowest.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.treatment_type_description FROM Treatment_types AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.treatment_type_code  =  T2.treatment_type_code GROUP BY T1.treatment_type_code ORDER BY sum(cost_of_treatment) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which professionals have done at least two types of treatments? List the professional id and cell phone.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.professional_id ,  T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

questions.question: What are the cost and treatment type description of each treatment?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.cost_of_treatment ,  T2.treatment_type_description FROM Treatments AS T1 JOIN treatment_types AS T2 ON T1.treatment_type_code  =  T2.treatment_type_code

questions.question: List pairs of the owner's first name and the dogs's name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T2.name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id

questions.question: Who owns the youngest dog? Give me his or her last name.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id WHERE T2.age  =  ( SELECT max(age) FROM Dogs )

questions.question: Find the number of professionals who have ever treated dogs.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT professional_id) FROM Treatments

questions.question: Which professionals live in a city containing the substring 'West'? List his or her role, street, city and state.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT role_code ,  street ,  city ,  state FROM professionals WHERE city LIKE '%West%'

questions.question: Find the role, street, city and state of the professionals living in a city that contains the substring 'West'.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT role_code ,  street ,  city ,  state FROM professionals WHERE city LIKE '%West%'

questions.question: Which owners live in the state whose name contains the substring 'North'? List his first name, last name and email.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT first_name ,  last_name ,  email_address FROM Owners WHERE state LIKE '%North%'

questions.question: How many professionals did not operate any treatment on dogs?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Professionals WHERE professional_id NOT IN ( SELECT professional_id FROM Treatments )

questions.question: Find the number of professionals who have not treated any dogs.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Professionals WHERE professional_id NOT IN ( SELECT professional_id FROM Treatments )

questions.question: What are the dog name, age and weight of the dogs that were abandoned? Note that 1 stands for yes, and 0 stands for no in the tables.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  age ,  weight FROM Dogs WHERE abandoned_yn  =  1

questions.question: What is the age of the oldest dog?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT max(age) FROM Dogs

questions.question: How much does each charge type costs? List both charge type and amount.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT charge_type ,  charge_amount FROM Charges

questions.question: Find the distinct breed type and size type combinations for dogs.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT breed_code ,  size_code FROM dogs

questions.question: List the first name of all the professionals along with the description of the treatment they have done.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T3.treatment_type_description FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id JOIN Treatment_types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code  =  T3.treatment_type_code
